scenes.title: Twenty-three months late
scenes.summary: Mathias accompanies Audrey Fleurot and her baby to the tax office; the inspector says she is 23 months late with her taxes and demands a cheque this week plus a 10% surcharge, while Mathias insists her comeback is imminent.

scenes.title: Sofia's headshots
scenes.summary: At reception Sofia shows Gabriel her new professional photos and he tells her she has grace; in the lift Andréa teases Gabriel about signing the receptionist.

scenes.title: The audit continues
scenes.summary: Colette Brancillon reminds the agents about her documents; Gabriel and Andréa complain that tax inspectors always find something.

scenes.title: Pitching Audrey to Augustin
scenes.summary: Mathias persuades the young web video star Augustin and his producer to cast Audrey Fleurot instead of unknown actress Armelle Borzek, claiming Audrey loves his online videos.

scenes.title: Noémie's climbing weekend
scenes.summary: Looking for painkillers after a rock-climbing course, Noémie chats with Hervé and then scolds Camille for saying 'bisou-bisou' to a star on the phone.

scenes.title: An ecologist stripper
scenes.summary: At a café with Audrey and her two small children, Mathias pitches Augustin's script about a militant ecologist stripper; Audrey loves the story until she learns the stripper is her part.

scenes.title: Too exotic or not enough
scenes.summary: On the street Gabriel argues on the phone with a casting director over typecasting Sofia, then encourages Sofia after three failed auditions.

scenes.title: A German buyer for ASK
scenes.summary: Hélène Kerr announces a generous offer for the agency from Jonas Hirsch in Berlin; the partners resist, while at a restaurant François urges Mathias to leave for StarMédia.

scenes.title: Dinner at the Barnevilles'
scenes.summary: At home Catherine wonders if Hippolyte is still seeing Andréa's assistant Camille; Mathias says it isn't smart of him and agrees to tell him to stop.

scenes.title: I see everything in your bills
scenes.summary: After Gabriel warns Andréa that Colette checked his suits at 7 a.m., Andréa runs into Colette in a clothes shop; Colette refuses dinner and says she can read Andréa's lonely life in her expense bills.

scenes.title: Clémentine's ambush
scenes.summary: Outside the shop Andréa's ex Clémentine ambushes her with a dramatic speech calling her a 'monster of seduction' and forgiving her in front of Colette.

scenes.title: The girdle and the children
scenes.summary: Audrey arrives at ASK with both children because she won't leave them with a stranger, and can barely breathe in a tight girdle before meeting Augustin.

scenes.title: Perfume for Laura Smet
scenes.summary: Hervé advises a fan on the phone what perfume to send Laura Smet.

scenes.title: Mathias says yes to StarMédia
scenes.summary: While Audrey reads Augustin's script, her little girl wanders out looking for her mother, and Mathias phones François to accept StarMédia's offer, overheard by Noémie.

scenes.title: A month in Canada, and a countess
scenes.summary: Augustin mentions a month's shoot in Canada that Mathias hadn't told Audrey about; meanwhile Gabriel convinces a costume-drama director to see Sofia.

scenes.title: Audrey's pole-dancing demo
scenes.summary: Asked if she can really pole dance, Audrey has Mathias hold the office door shut, uses the coat stand as a pole in front of Augustin, and wins the role.

scenes.title: Childhood photos
scenes.summary: Andréa sends Camille with Hippolyte on his scooter to his parents' house to choose childhood photos for his new cop-show role.

scenes.title: Caught by Catherine
scenes.summary: At the Barneville house Camille and Hippolyte look through his childhood photos and he tries to kiss her; she pulls away just as Catherine walks in and invites her to stay for dinner.

scenes.title: Noémie's heartbreak
scenes.summary: Mathias forgets his phone at the office; Noémie sees a text from StarMédia with his contract and cries on Hervé's shoulder in the washroom because Mathias is leaving without her.

scenes.title: Dinner with Dad
scenes.summary: Mathias comes home early and finds Camille at his dinner table with Catherine and Hippolyte; outside afterwards he orders Camille to stop seeing Hippolyte, and she tells him to tell his son why himself.

scenes.title: The pole-dancing class
scenes.summary: Audrey practises pole dancing with a coach, slips and bumps her son's head; when Mathias brings the contracts, she gives him a strict nanny questionnaire banning sugar.

scenes.title: Armelle's blisters
scenes.summary: Thinking Armelle Borzek is a nanny applicant, Audrey lets her in; learning Armelle is the actress she replaced and seeing her blistered hands, Audrey comforts her and gives the part back to her.

scenes.title: Audrey and Mathias fall out
scenes.summary: In the street Mathias is furious that Audrey gave up the role; Audrey says she cannot leave her small children for six months, and they part angrily.

scenes.title: Traitors and the Hotel Saint-Georges
scenes.summary: Word is out that Mathias is leaving for StarMédia; Arlette's dog bites his ankle and Andréa threatens to sue him, before Mathias warns them that Samuel paid for a room at the Hotel Saint-Georges with agency funds.

scenes.title: A side job for Kadropov
scenes.summary: Hervé explains to Camille that Russian billionaire Kadropov pays actresses to attend his birthday party in Paris as a 'side job'.

scenes.title: Our room as usual
scenes.summary: Andréa and Gabriel go to the Hotel Saint-Georges to cover up Samuel's room, spot Colette arriving to inspect the hotel, and pretend to be lovers asking for their usual room.

scenes.title: Twenty thousand euros
scenes.summary: Tabloid photos show Audrey at Kadropov's birthday party for 20,000 euros; Audrey cries to Mathias that she is exhausted and needed the money, and Mathias admits he isn't a good father.

scenes.title: Sofia gets the part
scenes.summary: Gabriel learns Sofia got a part in the costume drama — as a slave with a few lines — and when he tells her, she is thrilled to be in a film with JoeyStarr.

scenes.title: The truth on the rooftop
scenes.summary: On the agency roof Colette tells Andréa she wasn't fooled at the hotel; Andréa confesses they were trying to hide Samuel's room out of fear of her.

scenes.title: All for UNICEF, and OSS 117
scenes.summary: At a charity gala Audrey donates her 20,000-euro fee from Kadropov to UNICEF; backstage Mathias tells her Michel Hazanavicius wants her for the next OSS 117.

scenes.title: The German pulls out
scenes.summary: Arlette announces that the German buyer has pulled out after hearing Mathias was leaving; Hélène calls Mathias an idiot, and the partners believe he faked his departure to save ASK.

scenes.title: The hero of the day
scenes.summary: The agency toasts Mathias with champagne as the strategist who saved ASK; only Andréa suspects he really meant to leave.
